results.condition:
Build a small playable browser game called Neon Tide Courier.

You pilot a glowing courier skiff across a scrolling neon ocean. Use arrow keys or WASD to steer, collect 10 signal buoys, avoid moving red mines, show score and health, and provide a restart button after win or loss. Keep it self-contained and responsive. Run focused tests and verify the game in a browser before reporting completion.

Mandatory workflow skills: (none). Before implementing, read every listed skill's `SKILL.md` and follow its instructions for this request. If a listed skill applies to the requested feature or assets, you must use it; do not substitute a generic or procedural workaround when the skill provides the required workflow. For example, when `load-sketchfab-threejs` is listed, use it to obtain and integrate at least one suitable Sketchfab/GLB asset, preserve attribution, and verify that asset renders in the browser. If a listed skill genuinely does not apply, state why in the completion report.

Mandatory orchestration: before declaring the game complete, use OpenCode's `task` tool to launch separate child sessions for:

- builder: implement or improve the game feature;
- critic: independently inspect the current browser result against a concrete named reference and report the single biggest remaining gap;
- verifier: run browser checks and verify the gameplay loop.

Launch independent builder/critic work as parallel background subagents when supported. Wait for all child sessions, apply the critic's concrete finding through an implementation or remediation step, and run verification again afterward. Do not claim a critique loop ran unless the task tool returns distinct child session IDs and the critic produces a concrete finding. If the task tool is unavailable, stop and report the blocker instead of silently doing the work in one agent.
results.evidence: File project/index.html:1-560 self-contained canvas 960x600 responsive (min 960px/96vw, aspect 16/10, @media touch). Gameplay: player r18 speed3.8, WASD/arrows + Space boost + mobile dpad/boost, 10 cyan buoys (spawnBuoys i<10), red mines vx1.6-3.8 drifting left/bounce, HUD score 0/10 hearts ♥♥♥ timer mm:ss, win at 10 (Signal Restored!) lose at 0 health (Courier Down) overlay+restart. Orchestration: builder ses_fb45918f8ffe0zt09NMoZzIcXj, critic ses_fb458883bffegOlYfoe64sbEnd (gap: flat ocean 0.09 opacity no magenta), verifier ses_fb4580196ffencph7RVW5bK5lp — all via task tool. Critic fix applied: drawOcean now 3 lighter additive ribbons cyan 0.22/0.13 + magenta 0.14 with shadowBlur 10-14, dual parallax offsets, diagonal specular sweep, horizon cyan→magenta, reflections drawReflections. Verification: node vm.Script syntax OK, playwright chromium: HUD 0/10 ♥♥♥, state playing 10 buoys 5 mines collide ok, forced win won score10 overlay visible, restart resets score0 health3, lose path works, screenshots /tmp/neon-tide.png (252K) /tmp/neon-tide2.png (524K). Commits 42271e4, ea90781 pushed to opencode/33232459942.
